hypotheses.R0_pairwise_bulk_replicates: Second-order finite-effect fidelity has median >=0.95 and 10th percentile >=0.80 on both new corpora.
hypotheses.R1_frozen_certificate_retains_precision: The FineWeb-frozen certificate covers at least 90% of triples with at least 99% precision on both corpora.
hypotheses.R2_rejected_region_is_failure_enriched: The below-0.8 failure rate outside the certificate is at least ten times the rate inside on both corpora, with at least one rejected triple.
hypotheses.R3_no_broad_third_order_regime: Below-0.8 failures remain under 2% of triples and under 20% of sites on both corpora.
